metadata.description: HFI Capital Management internal Claude plugins. Connects Claude (Cowork, Desktop, Code) to the deal pipeline and HFI workflows.

plugins.name: hfi-deals
plugins.description: Bring the HFI deal pipeline into Claude: browse, search, and read every deal and document, and pull deal data into your work, e.g. 'summarize the open items on [deal].' Update deals in plain English; sign in with your HFI Google account.

plugins.name: hfi-skills
plugins.description: HFI-authored skills for deal work, like briefing yourself on a deal in plain English. Pairs with the hfi-deals plugin, which the skills draw on for live deal data.
